label: OpenFIGI (instrument identifiers)
terms_note: Search/Filter API without a key: 5 requests per minute, 100 results per page, at most 150 pages (15,000 results); with a free key 20 per minute (https://www.openfigi.com/api/documentation#rate-limit). The published schema types the /v3/search response as an array; the live API answers an object {data: [...], next}.

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: Optional OpenFIGI API key (sign up at https://www.openfigi.com/user/signup); raises the search limit from 5 to 20 requests per minute. Sent as X-OPENFIGI-APIKEY.

search_symbols.note: Keyword search over FIGIs (POST /v3/search {query, start}); symbol is the FIGI, raw carries ticker, exchCode, marketSector and compositeFIGI. The API always answers pages of 100 and ignores the page size, so the server returns `limit` results and a next_cursor that walks the rest of that page before asking for the next one (the page is held for 60 s, so walking it costs no extra searches). Pass next_cursor back as cursor. Without an API key only 5 searches per minute are allowed.

not_offered.me: No account endpoint; the optional API key is only a rate-limit tier.
not_offered.get_candles: OpenFIGI serves identifiers only (mapping, search, filter), no prices.
not_offered.get_series: No time series in the API (identifiers only).
not_offered.get_news: No news endpoint in the API.
